Poppy is hands down one of the best tools I’ve used for content creation. There genuinely isn’t anything else out there that works quite like it.

It makes the whole content process so much easier like researching ideas, breaking down other content, organising inspiration, developing angles, scripting, rewriting and editing everything in one place. Instead of constantly jumping between different AI tools, documents, tabs and notes, you can actually build out your ideas visually and work through the entire creative process inside Poppy.

For scripting especially, it’s been a game changer for me. Being able to bring different references, ideas and inspiration together and then turn that into structured content so quickly saves me a ridiculous amount of time. It feels much more like having an actual creative workspace than just another AI chatbot.

I also had a billing issue where, because of a glitch, I’d effectively been using Poppy without being charged for a period. They could easily have made the situation difficult, but they handled it incredibly fairly and helped me get everything sorted without trying to hit me with a huge backdated charge.

And a massive shoutout to Killian in support - he stayed with me for nearly an hour getting everything resolved and was genuinely so helpful throughout.

Amazing product, amazing support, and easily one of my favourite tools for content creation. If you create content regularly, it’s honestly hard to go back once you’ve built Poppy into your workflow.

I have been very impressed with my experience with Poppy so far. One of the things that immediately stood out to me is how easy and intuitive the platform is to use. There are a lot of AI tools out there that promise great results but require quite a bit of time just to figure out how to use them properly. With Poppy, I was able to understand the concept and start using the platform very quickly.

More importantly, the quality of the output has been excellent. Poppy makes it very easy to bring different sources of information and ideas together and actually do something useful with them. The results don't feel like generic AI output, especially when you take the time to give Poppy the right context and source material. That is where I think the platform really shines.

However, one of the things that impressed me the most actually happened outside of the product itself: their customer service.

Killian from the Poppy team personally scheduled an onboarding session with me to make sure that I understood the platform, knew how to use it properly, and could get the most value from it. I really appreciated that.

In today's AI/SaaS environment, it is very easy to sell someone a product, send them a few automated emails, and move on to the next customer. It is something completely different when someone from the company takes the time to personally make sure that you understand what you purchased and, more importantly, that you are actually able to succeed with it.

To me, that kind of involvement says a lot about the people behind the product and their commitment to their customers.

A great product is important, but a great product combined with a team that genuinely seems to care whether its customers succeed is much harder to find.

So far, Poppy has delivered on both.

The process includes uploading past videos, sharing background information and channel goals, and using YouTube templates to generate video ideas, scripts, and titles. I can also use the microphone feature to speak directly into Poppy, which helps the system tailor scripts to my natural speaking style.

The workflow can also include inspiration content, such as videos from experts, along with proven frameworks to further customize the output. The process is simple: I copy a prompt, paste it into the chat, and receive tailored video ideas, scripts, and viral title options.

Presentations can also be used as source material, allowing Poppy to turn existing content into YouTube-ready scripts and titles. Overall, the workflow makes content creation faster, easier, and more aligned with my voice and channel goals.

I'm very happy with this tool and with the people like Killian, who went the extra mile to help jumpstart my education.

What impressed me most was how well thought out the entire workflow is. Instead of trying to do everything in one chat, each step has its own dedicated conversation. This keeps the AI focused, improves the quality of the output, and makes the whole content creation process much more efficient.

Killian took the time to answer all of my questions with patience and professionalism. He even restored the credits I had unintentionally wasted while learning the platform and shared a content creation template to help me get started faster.

I would also like to thank the entire support team. Every time I had a question, they responded quickly, professionally, and with genuine kindness. You never feel like you're on your own. It's obvious that everyone at Poppy AI truly wants their users to succeed, and that level of support is something I really appreciate.

I've worked with tools like Canva and PixVerse before, but Poppy AI brings many of these workflows together in a much smarter way. I'm excited to integrate it into my daily content creation process and see how much time it will save me.

My first impression is extremely positive. Poppy AI is not only a powerful platform, but it's also backed by an outstanding team that genuinely cares about its users. A heartfelt thank you to Killian and the entire support team for the fantastic onboarding experience and continued support!

reviews.title: Quite intuitive, once core concepts clicked.
reviews.text:
I was way too impatient to wait for my onboarding call, so naturally I spent the 48 hours beforehand poking around Poppy AI on my own. I made mistakes. Lots of them.

I built things the wrong way, went down a few rabbit holes, and generally learned by pressing buttons to see what happened. Despite all that, by the time my onboarding session rolled around, I'd somehow created a board that was actually usable and already saving me time.

Then I met with Killian, my own personal onboarder.

He was knowledgeable, patient, and clearly knew the platform inside and out. In a surprisingly short amount of time, he helped me untangle the mess I'd created, streamline my setup, and understand how Poppy was intended to work. What had felt a little chaotic suddenly made a lot more sense.

What I like most about Poppy is that it doesn't just throw generic AI answers at me. It helps me build project-specific ecosystems using my own documents, notes, resources, and knowledge. As an author, I want to be writing books, not building social media campaigns and advertisements. Personalized output lets me hand-off the marketing and that's a huge advantage. 

There's definitely a learning curve, but it's not a steep one, especially with such solid onboarding support. Once the core concepts clicked, I found the platform quite intuitive.

Most importantly, it's already saving me time. That's ultimately what I want from any software I pay for.

If you're willing to spend a little time learning how it works, Poppy AI is a remarkably powerful tool with a team that genuinely wants you to succeed.
